purpose: Public facts about the Android signing identities of the Google Play application. Certificate SHA-256 fingerprints only: no key, keystore, password or credential of any kind belongs in this file. It records facts and decisions; it authorizes nothing. tool/verify_android_release.py reads it. Changing it needs a reviewed commit after the maintainer has confirmed the value in Google Play Console.

play_app_signing.custody: Google (Play App Signing). Must remain unchanged; the private key is not available to Cadena.
play_app_signing.source: Google Play Console, confirmed by the repository owner (Issue #72)

upload.active_note: Not recorded yet. A new, CadenaBitcoin-controlled upload key replaces the existing one (Issue #72). Record its certificate fingerprint here, in a reviewed commit, once Google has activated it. Until then the release tools take the expected fingerprint only from the operator's explicit option.

do_not_use.reason: The upload key that is being replaced by decision (Issue #72). It may still be registered in Google Play until the new key is activated, but no artifact built from this repository is to be signed with it.

not_recorded: Any staging signing identity (no Android staging key exists yet)
The fingerprint of the new upload key (see upload.active_note)
